info.description: Loopback-only JSON polling API for the Arena Hero Command Center (66 API + 5 static routes). Every route is request/response poll-json; there is no SSE or WebSocket surface. Only /api/map uses a weak HTTP ETag (304 when If-None-Match matches) with cache-control public, max-age=2. The WebSocket wire contract lives in the arena-hero-ts package.
